basic_info.description: Fixer Opportunity in Westwood Park!  This 1920 split-level home offers 1,237 sq. ft. of living space with a practical floor plan that includes a main level entry, living room, dining room, and kitchen.  Up a half flight of stairs you'll find two bedrooms plus a sunroom and the full bathroom. An internal staircase leads down to a large unfinished basement and both the basement and side door lead to the large yard. Set on a 3,262 sq. ft. lot, this property is ready for your creative touchperfect for contractors, investors, or homeowners seeking to customize their space. Prime location just moments from Monterey Blvd and Ocean Avenue amenities, Safeway, Whole Foods, cafes, MUNI, Balboa Park BART, and quick freeway access. An as-is sale with endless potential in a convenient and well-connected neighborhood!
